Actors count unique qualifying people; Creators count qualifying person/primary-role pairs. A person may have several creator roles. USA citizens counts unique qualifying people under the project's accepted citizenship evidence rules, across actors and creators. It is a confirmed lower bound within the reviewed sources.

**Wikipedia category rule (approved 2026-09-22):** For Alpha60 slice analysis, Wikipedia categories matching `American*_of_*descent` are accepted as authoritative for both the stated descent and inclusion in the USA citizen count. Spaces and underscores are equivalent: `American actors of Filipino descent` qualifies, including JB Tadena. This is the project's counting convention, recorded separately from direct citizenship evidence. Descent categories without the American prefix do not establish USA citizenship under this rule. Each category-based count retains the person-page revision, category link, and rule ID `wikipedia-american-of-descent-v1`.

**Round 3 rules:** X in an X-of-Y-descent category supplies nationality and project country-counting context; Y supplies descent. A populated reviewed Wikipedia citizenship field or Wikidata P27 list excluding USA resolves non-U.S. under the published list rule. Missing, failed, or partial lists remain unknown. Contradictory accepted U.S. evidence remains flagged for review. See References for source scope and evidence provenance.

## Slice ASIAN — `asian-led-global`

Definition: `asian-led-global-v3`. Coverage: partial: bounded public-source review; unresolved credits and identity evidence remain.

Confirmed Asian identity or named origin/descent in the Asia-28 reference boundary: Eastern, Southern and Southeastern Asia, explicitly including Taiwan (TWN). Reviewed diaspora evidence is retained; birth location and citizenship alone do not qualify.

No identity inference from name, appearance, citizenship, production country, or character. Only confirmed sourced actor/primary-creator evidence counts. Unknown is not a negative identity claim.

Reference set `asia-28` (28 entries): Afghanistan (AFG); Bangladesh (BGD); Brunei Darussalam (BRN); Bhutan (BTN); China (CHN); Hong Kong (HKG); Indonesia (IDN); India (IND); Iran (IRN); Japan (JPN); Cambodia (KHM); South Korea (KOR); Laos (LAO); Sri Lanka (LKA); Macao (MAC); Maldives (MDV); Myanmar (MMR); Mongolia (MNG); Malaysia (MYS); Nepal (NPL); Pakistan (PAK); Philippines (PHL); North Korea (PRK); Singapore (SGP); Thailand (THA); Timor-Leste (TLS); Taiwan (TWN); Vietnam (VNM).

### Asia-28 country-set rationale

**Asia-28 = Eastern Asia (8, including Taiwan `TWN`) + Southern Asia (9) + Southeastern Asia (11).** Approved 2026-09-24, this replaces Asia-27 by adding Taiwan. The grouping uses the [UN M49 subregions](https://unstats.un.org/unsd/methodology/m49/#geo-regions) as a reference, with `TWN` explicitly added by this project. M49 does not list Taiwan separately in its regional table; its FAQ explains that statistical code 158 can be used for the area.

Central and Western Asia are shown below for context and are outside the selected three-subregion union. The exact ISO-3 definition is:

```python
# Project Asia-28: three UN M49 subregions, with TWN explicitly included.
central_asia = ["KAZ", "KGZ", "TJK", "TKM", "UZB"]
eastern_asia = ["CHN", "HKG", "JPN", "MAC", "MNG", "PRK", "KOR", "TWN"]
southern_asia = ["AFG", "BGD", "BTN", "IND", "IRN", "MDV", "NPL", "PAK", "LKA"]
south_eastern_asia = ["BRN", "KHM", "IDN", "LAO", "MYS", "MMR", "PHL", "SGP", "THA", "TLS", "VNM"]
western_asia = [
    "ARM", "AZE", "BHR", "CYP", "GEO", "IRQ", "ISR", "JOR", "KWT", "LBN",
    "OMN", "PSE", "QAT", "SAU", "SYR", "TUR", "ARE", "YEM",
]

asia = eastern_asia + southern_asia + south_eastern_asia
```

For `asian-led-global`, confirmed sourced Taiwanese identity, named origin or descent now qualifies under this boundary. The generator carries forward the reviewed Taiwanese evidence already accepted in `aapi-led` and recounts qualifying actors and primary creators. Citizenship or birthplace alone does not establish identity. The AAPI union already includes this evidence; its membership rule continues to include reviewed Asian diaspora and Native Hawaiian/Pacific Islander identity or descent.

References: [geography](#reference-geography), [aapi](#reference-aapi), [round3](#reference-round3).

### Country occurrences

One distinct country association per actor-side cast entry per sampled work. Includes documented citizenship, nationality, descent, category counting context, and retained legacy annotations. Duplicate sources count once per country and entry; repeat appearances across works count again. These values do not assign slice identity.

Qualifying person-work citizenship dispositions: confirmed: 355; conflicting: 8; not_us_under_list_rule: 391; unknown: 29. Repeated people across works are counted here; unknown and conflicts remain review debt.

Coverage: 88 of 312 confirmed works have reviewed actor country associations. Missing annotations are not zeros. This is a descriptive chart of the selected works, separate from the evidence used to qualify their people.

<section class="h15-slice" id="aapi-led" markdown="1">

## Slice AAPI — `aapi-led`

Definition: `aapi-led-v2`. Coverage: partial: bounded public-source review; unresolved credits and identity evidence remain.

Union of asian-led-global and reviewed Asian diaspora (including Taiwanese) or Native Hawaiian/Pacific Islander identity/descent. This project union includes global participants; the AAPI reference itself is United States oriented. It does not assert American citizenship.

No identity inference from name, appearance, citizenship, production country, or character. Only confirmed sourced actor/primary-creator evidence counts. Unknown is not a negative identity claim.

Reference set `pacific-reference-v1` (22 entries): American Samoa (ASM); Cook Islands (COK); Fiji (FJI); Micronesia, Federated States of (FSM); Guam (GUM); Kiribati (KIR); Marshall Islands (MHL); Northern Mariana Islands (MNP); New Caledonia (NCL); Niue (NIU); Nauru (NRU); Palau (PLW); Papua New Guinea (PNG); French Polynesia (PYF); Solomon Islands (SLB); Tokelau (TKL); Tonga (TON); Tuvalu (TUV); Vanuatu (VUT); Wallis and Futuna (WLF); Samoa (WSM); Native Hawaiian community (Hawaii) (US-HI).

References: [geography](#reference-geography), [aapi](#reference-aapi), [round3](#reference-round3).

### Country occurrences

One distinct country association per actor-side cast entry per sampled work. Includes documented citizenship, nationality, descent, category counting context, and retained legacy annotations. Duplicate sources count once per country and entry; repeat appearances across works count again. These values do not assign slice identity.

Qualifying person-work citizenship dispositions: confirmed: 360; conflicting: 8; not_us_under_list_rule: 397; unknown: 29. Repeated people across works are counted here; unknown and conflicts remain review debt.

Coverage: 88 of 313 confirmed works have reviewed actor country associations. Missing annotations are not zeros. This is a descriptive chart of the selected works, separate from the evidence used to qualify their people.

## Slice AFRICAN — `african-led-global`

Definition: `african-led-global-v2`. Coverage: partial: bounded public-source review; unresolved credits and identity evidence remain.

Confirmed African identity or named African origin/descent in the Africa-60 reference boundary. Generic Black/African-American evidence without a named African origin is represented in black-led. African geography does not assign a race.

No identity inference from name, appearance, citizenship, production country, or character. Only confirmed sourced actor/primary-creator evidence counts. Unknown is not a negative identity claim.

Reference set `africa-60` (60 entries): Angola (AGO); French Southern Territories (ATF); Burundi (BDI); Benin (BEN); Burkina Faso (BFA); Botswana (BWA); Central African Republic (CAF); Côte d'Ivoire (CIV); Cameroon (CMR); Democratic Republic of the Congo (COD); Republic of the Congo (COG); Comoros (COM); Cabo Verde (CPV); Djibouti (DJI); Algeria (DZA); Egypt (EGY); Eritrea (ERI); Western Sahara (ESH); Ethiopia (ETH); Gabon (GAB); Ghana (GHA); Guinea (GIN); Gambia (GMB); Guinea-Bissau (GNB); Equatorial Guinea (GNQ); British Indian Ocean Territory (IOT); Kenya (KEN); Liberia (LBR); Libya (LBY); Lesotho (LSO); Morocco (MAR); Madagascar (MDG); Mali (MLI); Mozambique (MOZ); Mauritania (MRT); Mauritius (MUS); Malawi (MWI); Mayotte (MYT); Namibia (NAM); Niger (NER); Nigeria (NGA); Réunion (REU); Rwanda (RWA); Sudan (SDN); Senegal (SEN); Saint Helena, Ascension and Tristan da Cunha (SHN); Sierra Leone (SLE); Somalia (SOM); South Sudan (SSD); Sao Tome and Principe (STP); Eswatini (SWZ); Seychelles (SYC); Chad (TCD); Togo (TGO); Tunisia (TUN); Tanzania (TZA); Uganda (UGA); South Africa (ZAF); Zambia (ZMB); Zimbabwe (ZWE).

### Africa60 country-set rationale

**Africa60 = 54 sovereign countries + six separately coded areas.** The reference boundary follows the countries and areas grouped under Africa (002) in the [UN M49 geographic classification](https://unstats.un.org/unsd/methodology/m49/#geo-regions). The six additional codes preserve the geographic distinctions used in Alpha60 country data and sourced origin/descent evidence.

The additional areas are Western Sahara (`ESH`), Mayotte (`MYT`), Réunion (`REU`), Saint Helena, Ascension and Tristan da Cunha (`SHN`), British Indian Ocean Territory (`IOT`) and French Southern Territories (`ATF`). M49 places `ESH` in Northern Africa, `SHN` in Western Africa, and the other four in Eastern Africa. This is a statistical geographic grouping; the codes include territories and other areas with differing political status.

The exact ISO-3 breakdown is:

```python
# Africa 54: sovereign-country subset of the UN M49 Africa grouping.
africa_54_iso = [
    "AGO", "BDI", "BEN", "BFA", "BWA", "CAF", "CIV", "CMR", "COD", "COG",
    "COM", "CPV", "DJI", "DZA", "EGY", "ERI", "ETH", "GAB", "GHA", "GIN",
    "GMB", "GNB", "GNQ", "KEN", "LBR", "LBY", "LSO", "MAR", "MDG", "MLI",
    "MOZ", "MRT", "MUS", "MWI", "NAM", "NER", "NGA", "RWA", "SDN", "SEN",
    "SLE", "SOM", "SSD", "STP", "SWZ", "SYC", "TCD", "TGO", "TUN", "TZA",
    "UGA", "ZAF", "ZMB", "ZWE",
]

# Six additional separately coded areas.
africa_6_iso = [
    "ESH",  # Western Sahara
    "MYT",  # Mayotte
    "REU",  # Réunion
    "SHN",  # Saint Helena, Ascension and Tristan da Cunha
    "IOT",  # British Indian Ocean Territory
    "ATF",  # French Southern Territories
]

africa_60 = africa_54_iso + africa_6_iso
```

For `african-led-global`, this boundary is applied to confirmed African identity or named African origin/descent evidence for actors and primary creators. Qualifying works can be produced anywhere. The 54 + 6 breakdown documents the existing `africa-60` set used by this slice.

### Country occurrences

One distinct country association per actor-side cast entry per sampled work. Includes documented citizenship, nationality, descent, category counting context, and retained legacy annotations. Duplicate sources count once per country and entry; repeat appearances across works count again. These values do not assign slice identity.

Qualifying person-work citizenship dispositions: confirmed: 134; not_us_under_list_rule: 198; unknown: 12. Repeated people across works are counted here; unknown and conflicts remain review debt.

Coverage: 73 of 216 confirmed works have reviewed actor country associations. Missing annotations are not zeros. This is a descriptive chart of the selected works, separate from the evidence used to qualify their people.

### Country occurrences

One distinct country association per actor-side cast entry per sampled work. Includes documented citizenship, nationality, descent, category counting context, and retained legacy annotations. Duplicate sources count once per country and entry; repeat appearances across works count again. These values do not assign slice identity.

Qualifying person-work citizenship dispositions: confirmed: 653; not_us_under_list_rule: 326; unknown: 57. Repeated people across works are counted here; unknown and conflicts remain review debt.

Coverage: 127 of 382 confirmed works have reviewed actor country associations. Missing annotations are not zeros. This is a descriptive chart of the selected works, separate from the evidence used to qualify their people.

## Slice LATINX — `latinx-led-global`

Definition: `latinx-led-global-v2`. Coverage: partial: bounded public-source review; unresolved credits and identity evidence remain.

Confirmed named Latin American identity/origin/descent tied to the 20-place project boundary. Broad Hispanic/Latino labels without a named origin are represented in latinx-led.

No identity inference from name, appearance, citizenship, production country, or character. Only confirmed sourced actor/primary-creator evidence counts. Unknown is not a negative identity claim.

Reference set `latinx-20` (20 entries): Argentina (ARG); Bolivia (BOL); Brazil (BRA); Chile (CHL); Colombia (COL); Costa Rica (CRI); Cuba (CUB); Dominican Republic (DOM); Ecuador (ECU); El Salvador (SLV); Guatemala (GTM); Honduras (HND); Mexico (MEX); Nicaragua (NIC); Panama (PAN); Paraguay (PRY); Peru (PER); Puerto Rico (PRI); Uruguay (URY); Venezuela (VEN).

### Country occurrences

One distinct country association per actor-side cast entry per sampled work. Includes documented citizenship, nationality, descent, category counting context, and retained legacy annotations. Duplicate sources count once per country and entry; repeat appearances across works count again. These values do not assign slice identity.

Qualifying person-work citizenship dispositions: confirmed: 327; conflicting: 5; not_us_under_list_rule: 195; unknown: 2. Repeated people across works are counted here; unknown and conflicts remain review debt.

Coverage: 86 of 246 confirmed works have reviewed actor country associations. Missing annotations are not zeros. This is a descriptive chart of the selected works, separate from the evidence used to qualify their people.

### Country occurrences

One distinct country association per actor-side cast entry per sampled work. Includes documented citizenship, nationality, descent, category counting context, and retained legacy annotations. Duplicate sources count once per country and entry; repeat appearances across works count again. These values do not assign slice identity.

Qualifying person-work citizenship dispositions: confirmed: 346; conflicting: 5; not_us_under_list_rule: 196; unknown: 6. Repeated people across works are counted here; unknown and conflicts remain review debt.

Coverage: 86 of 259 confirmed works have reviewed actor country associations. Missing annotations are not zeros. This is a descriptive chart of the selected works, separate from the evidence used to qualify their people.

### Country occurrences

One distinct country association per actor-side cast entry per sampled work. Includes documented citizenship, nationality, descent, category counting context, and retained legacy annotations. Duplicate sources count once per country and entry; repeat appearances across works count again. These values do not assign slice identity.

Qualifying person-work citizenship dispositions: confirmed: 1455; conflicting: 3; not_us_under_list_rule: 1725; unknown: 105. Repeated people across works are counted here; unknown and conflicts remain review debt.

Coverage: 173 of 536 confirmed works have reviewed actor country associations. Missing annotations are not zeros. This is a descriptive chart of the selected works, separate from the evidence used to qualify their people.

<section class="h15-slice" id="mixed-led-global" markdown="1">

## Slice MIXED — `mixed-led-global`

Definition: `mixed-led-global-v2`. Coverage: partial: bounded public-source review; unresolved credits and identity evidence remain.

At least two independent identity families among qualifying actors/primary creators in the same media object. Asian/AAPI, African/Black, Latin American/Hispanic-or-Latino, and White each count once. This describes the work's credited composition, not every person's identity.

No identity inference from name, appearance, citizenship, production country, or character. Only confirmed sourced actor/primary-creator evidence counts. Unknown is not a negative identity claim.

References: [geography](#reference-geography), [race](#reference-race), [round3](#reference-round3).

### Country occurrences

One distinct country association per actor-side cast entry per sampled work. Includes documented citizenship, nationality, descent, category counting context, and retained legacy annotations. Duplicate sources count once per country and entry; repeat appearances across works count again. These values do not assign slice identity.

Qualifying person-work citizenship dispositions: confirmed: 2328; conflicting: 12; not_us_under_list_rule: 1990; unknown: 165. Repeated people across works are counted here; unknown and conflicts remain review debt.

Coverage: 142 of 460 confirmed works have reviewed actor country associations. Missing annotations are not zeros. This is a descriptive chart of the selected works, separate from the evidence used to qualify their people.

## References

<a id="reference-aapi"></a>
- [AAPI Equity Alliance: What does AAPI mean?](https://aapiequityalliance.org/what-does-the-term-aapi-mean-experts-explain-the-history/). Accessed 2026-09-22. United States community umbrella including Asian Americans, Pacific Islanders, and Native Hawaiians. Alpha60 implements the approved broader union.

<a id="reference-black"></a>
- [African Americans](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=African_Americans&oldid=1376182324). Accessed 2026-09-22. Community identity and ancestry; not interchangeable with citizenship or every African origin.

<a id="reference-latinx"></a>
- [Hispanic and Latino Americans](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Hispanic_and_Latino_Americans&oldid=1375517155). Accessed 2026-09-22. Identity/family origin regardless of race. The project Latin American boundary includes Brazil and Puerto Rico; Spain is outside that boundary but Hispanic evidence may qualify for latinx-led.

<a id="reference-geography"></a>
- [Approved geographic boundaries (canonical copy)](https://github.com/alpha60-devops/alpha60-swarm-metadata/blob/main/config/h15-v3-definitions.json). Accessed 2026-09-24. Asia-28 supersedes Asia-27 by adding Taiwan (TWN), approved 2026-09-24. It combines Eastern, Southern and Southeastern Asia using UN M49 subregions as a reference, with TWN added explicitly by this project; Central and Western Asia are outside this selected union. Africa-60 is unchanged. Sets include countries and areas. Pacific entries are a documented discovery reference, not an exhaustive definition or a geography-to-identity inference.

<a id="reference-race"></a>
- [US Census Bureau: About the topic of race](https://www.census.gov/topics/population/race/about.html). Accessed 2026-09-22. Identity boundaries are versioned project decisions. The historical White definition is retained visibly; Pacific Islander identity is kept separate in the evidence.

<a id="reference-round3"></a>
- [Round 3 country and citizenship method](https://github.com/alpha60-devops/alpha60-swarm-metadata/blob/main/docs/h15-round3.md). Accessed 2026-09-23. Versioned country relationships, category convention, closed citizenship-list rule, country-association occurrence grain, and coverage limits.
